subject.title: ci(windows): add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should the Windows PowerShell smoke lane include `pnpm build:strict-smoke` now, or should this PR narrow to commands that already pass until the build smoke is made Windows-safe?
rationale: The direction fits the canonical issue, but live PR CI proves one selected command is not safe in the target lane and the command set changes recurring Windows runner work.

options.title: Fix build smoke before merge
options.body: Keep the requested command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows `pwsh` and the PR includes redacted successful proof.

options.title: Narrow the first smoke
options.body: Remove `pnpm build:strict-smoke` from this PR and land only native PowerShell commands that already pass if maintainers accept narrower initial coverage.

options.title: Pause CI scope
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this PR until runner budget and Windows build-smoke ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Fix build smoke before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the requested command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows `pwsh` and the PR includes redacted successful proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent overlap across CI workflow stabilization and PowerShell-safe docs tooling adjacent to the proposed command set.
